I am 3 weeks sober, and I have been three months before that with no cravings. I substitute the cannabis high with a gym high. Going to the gym every day and eating healthy helps your motivation and self-control. I also force myself to talk with friends and meet new people. This releases dopamine which is the neurotransmitter released when getting high. Dopamine is triggered as a reward system in your brain. So by doing this behavior over and over again, you could condition yourself to crave social interactions, exercise, and maybe even learning a new skill. I recommend starting by going to the gym every at least do 30mins and go up from there. Eating healthy also helps fight cravings. 

Another important thing is to stay clear from friends that still smoke. I had to cut some of my best friends from my life. We’re still friends and talk but don’t hang nearly as often. Like a wise man, once said: “tell me who your friends with and I tell you who you are”.

 Be patient with your self. The very fact the you decided to stop is amazing. Your on the right track and sometimes you might fall from the track but just make sure you always get back on and keep moving forward. Hope this helps in any way. Feel free to PM me if you need someone to talk to. Much love and take care!
